purpose: Convert uncertainty, contradiction and creative alternatives into explicit, testable and claim-bounded routes inside the RLL repository.

records.question: Which result should be current when a complete historical run and a newer partial run disagree by omission?
known: RLL now has a structural run-manifest schema with field-level provenance.
A partial execution can contain TOKEN_VAZIO for a field measured numerically in an earlier lineage.
unknowns: Historical runs have not all been materialized into the new manifest schema.
No field-level precedence resolver is yet committed as the canonical implementation.

contradictions.statement_a: A historical complete artifact may contain a numerical Bayes result.
contradictions.statement_b: A newer partial artifact may expose the same field as TOKEN_VAZIO.
contradictions.resolution_gate: Materialize both manifests and evaluate precedence within a compatible lineage.

possibilities.statement: Precedence is resolved per field and lineage instead of replacing the entire prior run.
possibilities.promotion_gate: Encode the convention in a deterministic resolver and regression tests.

possibilities.statement: A lineage-aware resolver preserves valid numeric evidence while marking newer missing fields as non-superseding.
possibilities.falsifier: The resolver selects a compatible TOKEN_VAZIO field over an earlier complete numeric result.
possibilities.predicted_observation: The canonical snapshot retains the complete value and records the partial run as a non-superseding event.
possibilities.promotion_gate: Pass resolver tests over at least one historical and one partial manifest.

possibilities.statement: Runs are tributaries: a dry tributary does not erase water measured upstream.
possibilities.promotion_gate: Translate only into lineage and precedence tests; never cite the analogy as evidence.

exit_conditions.evidence_required: Two schema-valid manifests representing a complete and a partial compatible lineage.
exit_conditions.acceptance_criterion: Both manifests validate and preserve distinct run, commit, method and artifact provenance.

exit_conditions.evidence_required: Deterministic field-level resolver with regression coverage.
exit_conditions.acceptance_criterion: TOKEN_VAZIO never supersedes compatible complete evidence and incompatible lineages remain separate.

records.next_gate: Implement manifest materialization and field-level precedence.

records.question: Does an RLL parameter region remain compatible with independent growth-of-structure observations?
known: The repository contains background-expansion and growth-related routes.
Background compatibility alone does not establish perturbation or structure-growth compatibility.
unknowns: The canonical covariance-aware f_sigma8 likelihood and dataset lineage are not unified in one current run.
The stability of viable parameters under joint background and growth constraints remains open.

possibilities.statement: At least one prior-bounded RLL parameter region is jointly compatible with background and f_sigma8 data.
possibilities.falsifier: No sampled parameter region passes the preregistered joint fit and posterior-predictive thresholds.
possibilities.predicted_observation: A stable posterior region remains after adding growth data without collapsing to a boundary artifact.
possibilities.promotion_gate: Run a covariance-aware joint likelihood with preregistered priors and convergence diagnostics.

possibilities.statement: Independent growth data eliminate the background-compatible RLL region.
possibilities.falsifier: A converged joint posterior retains a stable non-boundary RLL region under sensitivity checks.
possibilities.predicted_observation: The posterior concentrates at a null or excluded boundary and predictive residuals remain unacceptable.
possibilities.promotion_gate: Compare RLL, LCDM, wCDM and CPL under the same dataset lineage and priors.

possibilities.statement: Expansion and growth are two shadows of one object, but neither shadow proves the other.
possibilities.promotion_gate: Use only to explain why independent likelihoods are required.

exit_conditions.evidence_required: Versioned f_sigma8 dataset, covariance or uncertainty model, license and SHA-256.
exit_conditions.acceptance_criterion: The dataset manifest is reproducible and no placeholder or synthetic row enters the real-data likelihood.

exit_conditions.evidence_required: Joint posterior and posterior-predictive report using identical baselines and priors.
exit_conditions.acceptance_criterion: Convergence, prior sensitivity and model-comparison outputs are all present and checksum-bound.

records.next_gate: Unify real growth data, covariance and joint model comparison.

records.question: Does RLL performance generalize to observations not used for parameter selection or model construction?
known: Optimization on the same observations used for evaluation can overstate apparent performance.
The repository preserves multiple observational routes and model-comparison artifacts.
unknowns: A canonical train-test split or temporal preregistration contract is not yet attached to the full scientific run.
Out-of-sample predictive calibration relative to LCDM, wCDM and CPL remains unmeasured.

possibilities.statement: RLL retains competitive predictive calibration on observations withheld from all fitting and design choices.
possibilities.falsifier: Withheld-data residuals or predictive scores are materially worse than preregistered baselines.
possibilities.predicted_observation: The held-out predictive distribution remains calibrated without post-hoc parameter adjustment.
possibilities.promotion_gate: Freeze model, priors and split before revealing held-out scores.

possibilities.statement: The strongest current fit improvements are primarily in-sample optimization effects.
possibilities.falsifier: Repeated withheld-set evaluations remain stable across split seeds and external datasets.
possibilities.predicted_observation: Performance degrades substantially when evaluated on observations excluded from fitting.
possibilities.promotion_gate: Run repeated or temporally ordered holdout evaluation with locked configuration.

possibilities.statement: No held-out result is promoted unless the split, metric and model version were locked first.
possibilities.promotion_gate: Encode the lock in a versioned preregistration manifest and CI check.

exit_conditions.evidence_required: Versioned preregistration defining fit data, held-out data, metrics, thresholds and model commit.
exit_conditions.acceptance_criterion: The contract predates or cryptographically commits to the held-out evaluation.

exit_conditions.evidence_required: Held-out predictions and equal-footing baseline comparison.
exit_conditions.acceptance_criterion: Results include uncertainty, residuals, predictive scores, checksums and no post-hoc refit.

records.next_gate: Create a preregistered held-out evaluation contract.

records.question: Which CMB validation level is sufficient for each class of RLL physical claim?
known: The repository contains a CMB backend route and documentation.
Compressed distance checks and full power-spectrum calculations support different claim scopes.
unknowns: The exact claim-to-backend matrix is not yet enforced as a machine-readable gate.
Sensitivity to perturbation implementation and nuisance assumptions remains route-dependent.

possibilities.statement: CMB evidence is divided into compressed, background-solver and full-spectrum tiers with separate allowed claims.
possibilities.promotion_gate: Create and validate a claim-to-backend tier registry.

possibilities.statement: Compressed CMB observables are sufficient only for narrowly scoped background-consistency claims.
possibilities.falsifier: A claimed background modification changes spectrum-level observables while passing compressed checks in a misleading way.
possibilities.predicted_observation: Claims outside background consistency require escalation to a Boltzmann and spectrum-level backend.
possibilities.promotion_gate: Map each claim to observables and demonstrate counterexamples across tiers.

possibilities.statement: A coarse lens locates the star; a spectroscope is required to describe its composition.
possibilities.promotion_gate: Use only to explain tiered evidentiary scope.

exit_conditions.evidence_required: Machine-readable mapping from claim type to required CMB backend and observables.
exit_conditions.acceptance_criterion: CI rejects a claim package whose requested scope exceeds the executed backend tier.

exit_conditions.evidence_required: At least one checksum-bound execution receipt per supported tier.
exit_conditions.acceptance_criterion: Each receipt records code commit, inputs, backend version, outputs and allowed claim scope.

records.next_gate: Formalize claim-to-backend tiers and attach execution receipts.

records.question: Which repository checks are actually required by the external GitHub branch-protection configuration?
known: Repository-local workflow and job existence can be validated.
Repository-local files do not prove external branch-protection settings.
unknowns: The current external required-check configuration has not been attached as evidence to the repository ledger.

possibilities.statement: Branch protection remains unverified until an authenticated configuration receipt is captured.
possibilities.promotion_gate: Attach an API or settings export receipt with date, branch and repository identity.

possibilities.statement: A lock drawn on a blueprint does not prove that the physical door is locked.
possibilities.promotion_gate: Use only to explain the distinction between repository code and platform configuration.

exit_conditions.evidence_required: Authenticated branch-protection or ruleset receipt for main.
exit_conditions.acceptance_criterion: The receipt lists required checks, enforcement state, branch, repository and capture time.

records.next_gate: Capture external GitHub configuration evidence without inferring it from YAML.

next_gate: Validate this ledger in CI, then implement the P0 provenance materializer and precedence resolver.
